title: Non-Markovian dissipation as a resource for quantum reservoir computing
summary: The control of open-system dynamics provides a powerful mechanism for using quantum information to process sequential tasks. While quantum reservoir computing typically relies on Markovian dissipation to process sequential data, the computational role of non-Markovian memory effects remains largely unexplored. We introduce a framework for quantum reservoir computing where non-Markovianity is explicitly modeled and regulated using fractional derivatives.
